components.explanation: One six-line scene; session.gd constructs and owns the board, HUD and entities; project settings.
Level JSON, tile rules, 4-neighbour A*, and the no-seal placement rule.
One fixed-step world loop running at 3x the source rate, times a player 1x/2x/3x.
Monster movement, flat damage, status timers and drawing; recovered monster stats.
Wave release cadence and the compounding health ramp that feeds take_damage.
Four delivery styles; Storm chain selection with the source coin flip.
F1 playtest overlay drawn in session._draw beneath the Grid child.
Tower targeting and procedural drawing shared with the HUD build bar and ghost; tower stat table.
Headless SceneTree suites; only the keyboard suite drives real input events.
Level validation and the load-error surface.

script = ExtResource("1")

## The Unity values were authored for a board where one tile was roughly one
## Unity unit. This board draws a tile at 64 px, so the same durations read as
## a crawl -- monsters crossed at 44 px/sec and wave 1 took 26 seconds.
##
## Rather than rewrite the recovered numbers (which would destroy the fidelity
## checks in tests/test_data.gd), the whole simulation clock runs faster.
## Every duration and speed scales together, so the recovered RATIOS are
## untouched: a tower still deals exactly the same damage per monster pass.
const BASE_SIM_SPEED := 3.0
const SPEED_STEPS: Array[int] = [1, 2, 3]

lines.append("(no towers placed)")

	var h: float = 16.0 * float(lines.size()) + 16.0
	draw_rect(Rect2(8, 66, 330, h), Color(0.05, 0.08, 0.06, 0.82))
	draw_rect(Rect2(8, 66, 330, h), Color(0.45, 0.85, 0.45, 0.5), false, 1.0)

TowerTuning.Element.STORM:
			canvas.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
				Vector2(2, -36), Vector2(-6, -25), Vector2(-1, -25),
				Vector2(-4, -17), Vector2(6, -29), Vector2(1, -29)]), Color("ffe680"))
	if is_upgraded:
		# Upgrade marker: a small chevron, readable without relying on colour.
		canvas.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
			Vector2(0, 4), Vector2(6, 12), Vector2(-6, 12)]), Color("ffe680"))

grid = Grid.new()
	add_child(grid)
	if not grid.load_level("res://levels/level_01.json"):
		# Board could not be built. _draw shows the reason instead of a
		# half-initialised grid, and the session stays out of PLAYING.
		state = State.MENU

exclusions.reason: Version-control ignore list; no runtime role.
Export presets (macOS, Windows, Linux). Exports were not run or shown in this film; every capture ran the project from source.

code_result_pairs.observation: Boot of the real main scene: board, HUD and menu card appear; START begins a run.
Keys 2, 4 and Esc and a right-click, delivered as input events, drive build mode and refusals.
Seal of the spawn corner refused with "Would block the path"; a tower on the road accepted and the route changes.
SPEED button to 2x, F to 3x, F back to 1x, during waves 2 and 3.
Wave 1 against an upgraded Fire tower: hits flash white, bars drop, kills raise gold from 0 to 8.
The poisoned lead monster of wave 2 stays pale white rather than green.
The beam is visible for frames 173-178 (0.2 s) at real speed, then replayed at 1/8 speed, labelled.
The F1 overlay is cut off at the board edge; only its left 88 logical px are visible.
An upgraded Fire tower gains the chevron; the panel reads SELL 34 and MAXED.
Receipt keyboard-1790012997.43825.json: 8 of 9 FAIL with the fix reverted; keyboard-1790606725.01996.json: 9 of 9 PASS.
With level_01.json missing "exit": the error panel is covered by the menu card; Enter sets PLAYING and Space starts wave 1 behind a frozen HUD.
